## propertyTypeToZod() function

Convert manifest property type to Zod schema code.

Handles three categories of types: - Primitive types (string, number, boolean, date, etc.) - Complex types (arrays, resource references, enum references) - Custom type references (arbitrary strings referencing resources/enums)

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare function propertyTypeToZod(type: PropertyType | undefined, optional: boolean): string;
```

**Returns:**

Zod schema code string

## Example


```typescript
propertyTypeToZod('string', false)           // => 'z.string()'
propertyTypeToZod({ array: 'number' }, false) // => 'z.array(z.number())'
propertyTypeToZod({ enum: 'Priority' }, true) // => 'PrioritySchema.optional()'
```
